card.name: Ends of capitalized label headings
card.fires_on: The last piece of an all-caps word in label headings or warnings, especially the final S of CONTRAINDICATIONS or MEDICATIONS. It also fires partway through other capitalized words like ACCOMPANIED or CONTAINER.

modes.label: Plural S in headings
modes.description: The final S of an all-caps plural such as CONTRAINDICATIONS or MEDICATIONS.

modes.label: Inside all-caps warning words
modes.description: A middle piece of a long capitalized word in a warning sentence.
modes.example: DO NOT USE PLASTIC<< CONT>>AINER IN SERIES CONNECTION.

card.writes: It suppresses the word AND, so the next word is not 'and', and it weakly promotes odd accented-character pieces.
card.plain: It marks the end or middle of shouted all-caps label words, such as the S in CONTRAINDICATIONS.
